author: Keel (brief 098 step 0, 2026-11-07)
rule: The dial (brief 098 step 0; Sky 2026-11-07: "I should say, add 3 more guards, take some away, bring in more cars etc - the game then just does that, no long processing, and I play and get a feel"). A start sets how many of each kind the zone has (start.counts: guards, the whole zone's count of them, the cast included; people, how many are on the street at a time on average, the cast included (brief 098 step 1b, Sky 2026-11-07: "people counter is for street"); cars, how many are on the zone's roads at a time on average); the engine builds that world when the game starts, from the seed and these rules, with no generator run. A kind the start does not set plays the people file exactly, and a start that sets none hashes and plays as before: this file is read only when a start sets counts, and then its text is hashed into that start, so seed + counts + orders replay exactly against it. Part of Keel's rulebook (contracts/rules/rulebook.json keeps its own bytes, so no recorded run moves). Unknown = reject.

guards.name: Guard
guards.src: brief 098 step 0: the people file's guards (job guard; 16 in the Handover, the door guard among them) plus any the dial adds; people.rules temperamentsBy.roles.guard (Loyal or Mercenary, never Idealist or Fearful)
guards.reason: an added guard is named by a stand-in (Guard 1, Guard 2, ...): the engine has no name rules (the names are drawn by the people generator from contracts/people/names at build time). 400 keeps a hopeless setting playable in time.

people.name: Passer-by
people.src: brief 098 step 0: everyone else in the people file (114 in the Handover, Inez, the driver and Popovic among them) plus any the dial adds; people.rules temperamentsBy.roles.visitor (a simulated person who neither lives nor works in the district). Brief 098 step 1b (Sky 2026-11-07: "people counter is for street"): the count is of people on the street (in the zone, out of doors) at a time on average over the mission's clock, the cast included: about 19 today, of the zone's 114
people.reason: measure street: a person's street time is the ticks their routine has them out of doors inside the window from 0:00 to the close (the people file's stops and legs, with the game's seeded shift of their day; an added passer-by's visit; the cast by the people file's stops for them); the count is the sum over the clock. More adds passers-by in id order until the street holds the count (the nearest a whole passer-by allows; one whose visit misses the clock is not added); fewer takes street time away (fewer). An added person is a passer-by named by a stand-in (Passer-by 1, ...): the engine has no name rules. They carry no need record (the cell turns only the cast: Ask, Help and Pressure are never offered to the crowd) and no ties. 500 on the street (about 2,000 passers-by) keeps a hopeless setting playable in time.

cars.src: brief 098 step 1 (law L8; Sky 2026-11-07: "our roads are empty, no reason can't have passing traffic"; "bring in more cars etc - the game then just does that"): passing cars on the zone's lanes (sim/data/handover.lanes.json), each a real car of the engine (GameCars.cs, Sky 2026-10-21: "shootable, as in Syndicate"): a target, solid, and cover where it stands
cars.reason: a count is how many cars are on the zone's roads (inside the walk window) at a time on average: the engine runs enough of them through the mouths, each trip a new car (car:t-<slot>-<trip>) with a stand-in driver at the wheel. 0 today (the roads are empty); unset is no traffic at all. 64 is about every lane full at its gap: a hopeless setting still plays in time.

fewer.src: brief 098 step 0: people above the count leave by a stable order, never a tenet; GDD §05 security: a post is one person's, a relief waits beside it and keeps its marks. Brief 098 step 1b (Sky 2026-11-07, who leaves when a count is lowered: "same for now"): the people (measure street) leave by the same order, and only those whose routine brings them out
fewer.reason: the order is a hash of each person's id (fnv1a32 of id/salt, ties by id), the same every game and every seed, so a count is one world shape and the seed moves only its timings, and taking one more away never brings anyone back. Never a tenet: the mission's cast (the site's cast) and anyone a cast member's lover tie names. Guards leave off-post ones first; then a post's reliefs, the latest shift first, the one before standing the post on to the end of the shift that left; then the posts themselves: a post is staffed for its whole shift or not at all, never half. People leave in the order until the street holds the count (the nearest a whole person allows), passing over anyone whose routine keeps them indoors all mission (the clerks at their desks, the cooks: they change nothing on the street and stay); the cast never leave, so the fewest on the street is the cast's own street time.

beat.src: brief 098 step 0: an added guard is on shift, on a beat between post points the engine finds in the site: its staffed doors (a post beside the door, off its way: engine 0.50.0, rulebook bodies.door, Aster's ruling on 0.49.0, "A door's guard stands to one side of the door"; so the door's own post stays its holder's and people pass between), its police posts (the takedown file's street posts) and its call boxes (which stand at the corners, R-REPORT); GDD §05 every staff post checks in by voice every 90 s from the start of its shift (rulebook check-in-period-s)
beat.reason: a beat is size points: the guard's first post point (spread over the points in a seeded order, one guard to a point before any shares) and the size - 1 nearest to it, walked in a loop at the city's walk (crowd.walk), pausing pauseS at each, facing out of the door or to the kerb. His shift runs from shiftBeforeS before 0:00 to shiftAfterS after the close, at a seeded phase; his marks run every check-in period from it. The site carries no gates yet (the plan's gates are not in the sim site), so a beat finds none. Pulse to tune.

passers.src: brief 098 step 0: an added city person is a passer-by who enters at the site's edges at a seeded time, walks to a seeded destination, lingers and leaves. Brief 098 step 1b: they are added until the street holds the people count asked
passers.reason: the edges are the runs of free cells on the walk grid's border (a street or a path leaving the window), at least edgeMinCells wide, entered at the middle of each; a run longer than edgeSpanCells (a street along the border) is split evenly, so people come in along it, not at one point. A passer-by enters at a seeded second in enterS (mission seconds; before 0:00 they are already walking when the mission starts) and goes to a destination by these weights: a café seat (the people file's chairs) free for the whole linger, sitting there lingerS.seat; a public door of the site's buildings (the café, the Office), inside for lingerS.door; or another edge, walking straight through. Then out by a seeded edge. The site has no benches or transit stops yet, so neither is a destination. Temperament: the role's allow list (people.rules temperamentsBy.roles), weighted by the zone's own mix of that kind, no temperament above temperamentsBy.mix.rowMaxShare. Pulse to tune.

traffic.src: brief 098 step 1, law L8 (Sky 2026-11-07: "Drivers keep to their lanes, stop for people in the road and for cars ahead ... brake or flee at gunfire. Roads close in a lockdown. A car is a car: it can be shot, hidden behind or blown up"): the kit's vehicles at budget (out/world/harbour-district.presentation.json models: car/* the sedans, van/box BoxTruck_Play, scooter/hover HoverScooter; its notes: vans 8 %, scooters 4 % of traffic); size [length, width] cm, the models' footprints (the sedan's is the rulebook's car.footprint); cover, the kinds a body can hide behind
traffic.reason: each trip draws its kind by the mix; its footprint is what it blocks on the walk grid, its gap and its cover. Every kind is a car under the rulebook's car.target (health, disabled, burning, the blast); a standing sedan or van is cover on its four sides as the mission's cars are (their sides' and ends' cover, the site's car points), a scooter none. Forma's civilian set at budget replaces the sedans' repaints later.

drive.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 lanes and stopping: a driver keeps to the lane's line at its speed (the lanes file: life.json traffic.byClass speed), keeps gapCm plus headwayDs tenths of a second of its speed behind whatever is ahead in its lane within lookCm (a car, the cell, the city's people, the cast, a body), and stops peopleGapCm short of a person; the corridor it keeps clear is its width plus clearCm each side
drive.reason: a city driver's 1.2 s headway and 2 m standstill gap; 2 m/s2 to pull away, 4.5 m/s2 to brake, 8 m/s2 at a sudden alarm (a hard stop); 25 m ahead is what a driver at 5 m/s watches; 30 cm each side keeps two cars in neighbouring lanes apart. Pulse to tune.

trips.src: brief 098 step 1: each slot of the count runs one car at a time through the zone: in at a seeded mouth, out at another, then a seeded offS before its next trip (a new car); the game starts with warmS of traffic already run, so the roads are full at 0:00
trips.reason: enough slots that the mean on the zone's roads is the count (the slots' share of time inside the window, from the routes' lengths at their speeds); every draw is the slot's own (seed, slot, trip), so a higher count adds slots and moves no car already there

stand.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 a car is a car: a car stopped standS is standing (rulebook car.footprint: ground nobody walks through; cover where it stands); one stopped settleS (or disabled, burning, abandoned, its driver ducked) is settled: the crowd's routine legs set out round it, as round the mission's standing cars. Brief 098 step 1b (Sky 2026-11-07, on Keel's open question "a queue boxes nobody in": "should be opposite - shot cars can get past, others block"): a standing car that has not been shot (queued, waiting at a junction or for a person, its driver ducked or pulled up) boxes a way out it stands on (car.box), as any solid car does; a car that has been shot (disabled, burning, blown, or abandoned by a driver who got out at the shot) never boxes anyone in: a mission car pushes it aside (traffic.shove)
stand.reason: a car pausing for someone crossing is not yet a wall; a queue that waits is, and it boxes the cell's car in until it moves on, so a jam can trap a mission car and shooting the car in the way clears it. The crowd's legs are walked again only for settled cars, so a queue's stop and go does not re-walk the city each second.

pass.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 stopping: a driver held up waitS behind something that will not move on (a standing mission car, a wreck or an abandoned car, a body) eases round it within its own half of the road when there is room, at latCmS across and passCmS along; with no room there, out across the centreline as far as the oncoming lane's line when that lane holds no car that could meet it before it is past (an overtake: meanwhile no junction lets a car into that lane); round a person on their feet only once they have stayed in the road 5 waitS, a body's width wider. Seen from afar the driver eases out early, still rolling; stopped too close to swing out, they back off up to backCm where the road behind is clear, and try again
pass.reason: the official car at its kerbside stop and the rival car's block reach into a lane by less than its spare width: drivers squeeze by. A car or a person that fills the lane (the rival wheelman standing in Apron Road by his parked car) is overtaken when the other way is clear; while it is not, the cars behind it wait and the rest find another way at the junction before.

yield.src: brief 098 step 1: the mission's cars (the getaway car, the official car, the rival car) drive their own timetables (tenets); traffic yields to them by the same law: a moving mission car's next aheadS of road is a car in the way (unless it comes up from behind: the driver ahead drives on), a driver it comes at pulls aside within their half where there is room, and no junction is entered that it will cross within aheadS; the rival car's turn-in point (on the street from its timetable, mid-junction at Orbit Walk's mouth) is kept clear from entryS before it comes. Brief 098 step 1b (Sky 2026-11-07: "shot cars can get past, others block"): a mission car is a car: one whose next place on its leg would meet a passing car that has not been shot holds there, its leg's clock waiting, for as long as that car is in its way (no limit: a jam can hold it); one that would meet a wreck pushes it aside (traffic.shove). A passing car that stands in a mission car's way waiting for that very car gets out of its way: sideways within its half where there is room, else backing off up to pass.backCm where the road behind is clear
yield.reason: 3 s at 5 m/s is 15 m: a driver sees a car coming and lets it by. A mission car no longer drives on through a car after a while (step 1's holdS, 40 s, is gone): ordinary traffic is solid, so it waits behind a queue until the queue moves, and two cars that would wait for each other are untied by the passing car making room. A leg a mission car starts goes round the passing cars standing then (the drive grid's route round their ground) where it can.

shove.src: brief 098 step 1b (Sky 2026-11-07: "shot cars can get past, others block"; the brief: "Make it visible and physical, not a ghost: for example the wreck is pushed toward the kerb as the car goes by"): a mission car whose next place on its leg would meet a passing car that has been shot (disabled, burning, blown, or abandoned) pushes it aside: away from its own line, toward the side the wreck's centre is on (its right, the kerb, at a tie), at cmS, never into a building, street furniture or another car; it holds while it pushes (its leg's clock waits) and drives on once the wreck is clear of its next place. A wreck is pushed maxCm at most in all; one that cannot be pushed further either way (pinned against a wall or a car) holds the car as any car does. A Go (or the lent car's) whose way out a wreck stands on is taken: the wreck is pushed off the way as the car leaves
shove.reason: 1.5 m/s is a car nudging a wreck at a crawl: a sedan in the middle of a lane is clear of a passing car's line in about a second and a half, which the player sees. 6 m keeps a wreck on the street: far enough to clear a lane and the next, never across the district. Pulse to tune.

react.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 gunfire (Sky 2026-11-07: "Pull a gun out in front of someone they run away ... based on their nature"): a driver who hears a shot within crowd.scatter of the car, or sees a drawn weapon in their cone (perception.people, the car's heading their facing), brakes hard and stops; then by nature they duck at the wheel until it has been quiet crowd.quiet, or drive off fast (fleePm per mille of the lane's speed) the way they were going, still stopping for anyone in the road; a driver whose car is shot gets out and runs (the crowd's flight)
react.reason: the Fearful freeze and the Loyal wait for the police; the Mercenary and the Idealist want out. The startle before acting is the crowd's (crowd.startle, the Fearful's shorter). A ducked driver sees nothing. Motive to set the natures' answers with step 2's witness laws.

lockdown.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 roads close: from this Alert (3, lockdown) no car comes in: an inbound car stops short of the window's edge; the cars already in the zone carry on out (leave) or pull up where they are (stop). Sky 2026-11-07, on Keel's open question (leave or stop): "Drive out": leave
lockdown.reason: Sky's decision: a sealed street empties of cars, so after a lockdown traffic boxes nobody in. stop (they pull up for good, boxing whatever they stand on) stays built for a later mission.

driver.name: Driver
driver.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 drivers are people: each car's driver is a person with a temperament from people.rules temperamentsBy.roles.visitor (weighted by the zone's own mix of people, the dial's rule), who sees by their cone and reacts by their nature; out of their car they are a passer-by of the crowd (they witness, scatter, block sight)
driver.reason: a driver passing through neither lives nor works in the district: a visitor. Stand-in names (Driver 1, ...) as the dial's added people; no need record, no ties. At the wheel a driver reports nothing (news travels on foot: step 2's witness laws decide what a driver who saw something does).
